trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.wrong: What matters it is friendship, and it is friendship what lasts.
trap.right: What matters is friendship, and it is friendship that lasts.
trap.why: Português repete o pronome “isso”; o pseudo-cleft não usa it, e a clivada pede that.

mcq.q: In a cleft, the stressed word follows…

opts: What matters is trust. / It is trust that matters.
What matters is trust. / It is trust who matters.

rewrite.prompt: Transforme em clivada: “What lasts is friendship.”
